My review of Northstar's executed pledge agreement, completed this week, shows two important requirements: first, the agreement requires two business days' notice before releasing the existing collateral, and second, a tri-party control agreement must be signed before the replacement collateral is released. I have not yet added these clauses to the transaction checklist, but I'm disclosing them now as part of the pre-decision routine.
